h: לְעֶרֶב יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים, ח׳ Erev Yom Kippur, 8

p: בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רִיד, ב):
מֵרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה עַד יוֹמָא בַּתְרָאָה דְּחַג:
from Rosh Hashanah until the last day of the Chag:
on Rosh Hashanah the left arm is aroused
before the Holy One, blessed be He.
and the members of the palace must,
on the ninth of the month,
for the union of the Matronita
'His left hand is under my head,' etc.
בְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה אִתְּעַר דְּרוֹעָא שְׂמָאלָא וְכוּלֵּי,
"On Rosh Hashanah the left arm is aroused," etc.,
is what he said just before it:
and as Rabbi Chaim Vital wrote
So too we find in the Gemara (Shabbos 31a):
and this is judgment and gevurah.
And this is what he said:
"And when this one is aroused toward her,
how many fears dwell in the world," etc.;
"the whole world is in fear of judgment."
לָמָּה נִצְרְכוּ שְׁנֵי יָמִים דְּרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה
why the two days of Rosh Hashanah were needed
הַיּוֹם אִם בְּקוֹלוֹ תִשְׁמָעוּ (תְּהִלִּים צה, ז),
"Today, if you will listen to His voice" (Tehillim 95:7),
expounds it as referring to the day of Shabbos;
וְעַל כָּל פָּנִים דַּי בְּיוֹם אֶחָד.
at any rate, one day is enough.
(זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קכט, סוֹף עַמּוּד א):
in one day, in one moment,
they draw near to the Holy One, blessed be He";
so not even one day is needed;
why then were designated for this
the two days of Rosh Hashanah?
before the Holy One, blessed be He,
עוֹד שִׁבְעָה יָמִים עַד יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים?
seven more days until Yom Kippur?
"and the members of the palace must, on the ninth of the month,
we find nothing regarding Erev Yom Kippur
רַק כָּל הָאוֹכֵל וְשׁוֹתֶה בַּתְּשִׁיעִי וְכוּלֵּי;
except "Whoever eats and drinks on the ninth," etc.;
so that it will be easier for you,
to eat bread on Erev Yom Kippur.
אַךְ לְפֵירוּשׁ רַשִׁ"י (רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה ט, א):
But according to Rashi's explanation (Rosh Hashanah 9a),
it appears that there is a mitzvah
it appears that they were accustomed to make it plentiful
and there is the story of the tailor,
But a mitzvah of simchah we do not find.
after all, it is on Sukkos that
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ אַחַר כָּךְ:
as the holy Zohar says afterward:
it is the rejoicing of the Torah," etc.
that every year there is aroused on Rosh Hashanah
"Today is the birth of the world,"
just as Adam HaRishon was then created
on Rosh Hashanah, which was the sixth day,
which is a time of teshuvah,
as it is said, "It is good to give thanks to Hashem"
שֶׁכָּל מִי שֶׁמּוֹדֶה עַל פְּשָׁעָיו וְכוּלֵּי
meaning that whoever confesses his sins, etc.
וּפִרְקֵי דְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר פְּרָקִים יט וְכ).
and Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer chapters 19 and 20).
And it says in the Pesikta (Rabbasi 46:1)
that the day of Shabbos protected him,
שֶׁהִמְתִּין לוֹ הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת
for Hashem Yisbarach waited for him the day of Shabbos,
perhaps he would return and rectify everything;
וְכֵן כָּתוּב בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה כא, ו):
and so it is written in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 21:6):
that He opened for him a door of teshuvah,
And when the day of Shabbos passed
and he was banished from Gan Eden on Motzei Shabbos,
on the first day of the week
he already wished to return in teshuvah
Then he needed the seven weekdays,
that they be seven clean days.
And had he returned in teshuvah
for the entire blemish and downfall,
there would afterward have been the complete tikkun,
the days of judgment are aroused on Rosh Hashanah,
and then, if Yisrael do teshuvah,
they are redeemed immediately in Tishrei
that through teshuvah they are redeemed in Tishrei);
so that they be stirred to teshuvah;
"and then the whole world is in fear of judgment,
and at that time, in complete teshuvah,
one must be found before the Holy One, blessed be He."
From the side of the Holy One, blessed be He,
as with Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him —
like Adam HaRishon before the downfall;
yet he, from his own side,
feared lest sin bring about harm
like a woman who becomes pure for her husband;
and then on the seventh day
there is joy for the Matronita,
which is preparation for the union of the King.
And this is what he said:
"and the members of the palace must
and immerse in the river to purify themselves
for the union of the Matronita on the next day;
to place the left arm beneath her head," etc.;
that is, on Erev Yom Kippur
the joy comes from its being
the seventh day of the seven clean days,
וְהִיא הֲכָנָה לַזִּיוּוּג שֶׁל יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים.
and it is preparation for the union of Yom Kippur.
And as for what he said, "to immerse in the river" —
rather it is as the Rambam wrote
there is an allusion in the matter, etc.:
one who directs his heart to purify his soul
from the impurities of the soul, etc.,
and brings his soul into the waters of knowledge
That is, the period of the seven days
between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur,
is to be seven clean days,
and to be purified in the waters of knowledge,
that was given over to baalei teshuvah;
and this is immersion in Nehar Dinur, the river of fire.
And from this one merits joy
for the union on Yom Kippur.
And then is the time for everything to be rectified.
And this is what he said:
"and then Yisrael are fasting over their sins,
has illuminated the face of the Matronita
From the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
everything was already rectified from Rosh Hashanah;
but from the side of Yisrael there is fear,
and seven clean days are needed.
the time when there is rectified
the entire root of the blemish
that was in the three kelipos:
the downfall was in desire and bodily pleasure;
there emerged the kelipah of murder and jealousy;
the kelipah of avodah zarah came into actuality —
the full development of the yetzer hara.
In truth all the kelipos were included
שֶׁאֵין לְהַשְׁגִּיחַ עַל צִיוּוּי הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ,
that one need not heed the command of Hashem Yisbarach,
which is akin to heresy and avodah zarah;
אַךְ לְפוֹעַל יָצָא אַחַר כָּךְ בְּזַרְעוֹ.
but it came into actuality only afterward, in his offspring.
that Adam HaRishon should rectify everything entirely.
And since it was not rectified,
on Rosh Hashanah, two days of teshuvah,
remarked on why they did not mention
And truly, why was it stated,
the mitzvah to eat and drink
that there is a mitzvah in bodily pleasure;
מַה שֶּׁאֵין כֵּן בְּעֶרֶב יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים,
which is not so on Erev Yom Kippur,
where the mitzvah is to rectify the root of the blemish,
and the eating must be like affliction,
so that he feel no pleasure at all,
only to fulfill the mitzvah of his Creator,
the entire root of the blemish in eating.
that the reason for the mitzvah to eat
when he withdraws from eating and drinking
(along the lines of what they said,
And perhaps this is what Rashi, of blessed memory, said
"And since his eating is considered affliction,
whoever increases in eating and drinking
so that the affliction will be greater on Yom Kippur.
why it does not say (in Pesachim),
bodily pleasure was not permitted at all,
only eating for the sake of Heaven,
and for the body there will be extra affliction.
שֶׁאָז גְּמַר הַתִּיקּוּן עַל יְדֵי תְּשׁוּבָה
then is the completion of the tikkun through teshuvah
in Nehar Dinur, in the waters of knowledge —
over the next day, when the union will be;
'and for the upright in heart, joy'" (Tehillim 97:11).
יִהְיֶה רַק כְּמוֹ מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן יוֹסֵף,
will be only like that of Mashiach ben Yosef,
who will gather the dispersed of Yisrael
חָשַׂף ה׳ אֶת זְרוֹעַ קָדְשׁוֹ וְכוּלֵּי,
"Hashem has bared His holy arm," etc.,
but nevertheless there will still be
an existence for the nations of the world,
who will gather from all seventy nations
עַל ה׳ וְעַל מְשִׁיחוֹ (תְּהִלִּים ב, ב).
And although if the tikkun is as it should be
there will be no fear of him,
"He Who sits in heaven laughs," etc. (ibid. 4),
nevertheless from the side of Yisrael
עַל מָשִׁיחַ בֶּן יוֹסֵף שֶׁנֶּהֱרַג וְכוּלֵּי;
about Mashiach ben Yosef who is killed, etc.;
but if the tikkun is as it should be,
he will not need to be killed.
"the time of our rejoicing" from the side of Yisrael,
when they too will know that it is joy.
And this is what he said:
"On the first day of the Chag
the right arm is aroused toward her
and there is rejoicing with clear waters
to be poured upon the altar."
That is, then begins the tikkun
which will come through the holiness of the Avos,
for the three middos Chesed, Gevurah and Tiferes,
and they are branches of the first three sefiros,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב יד, ב):
"He made Avraham in the secret of Chochmah,
Yitzchak in the secret of Tevunah,
Yaakov in the secret of Daas."
And this is what he said: "all is rejoicing" —
and to the attribute of Chochmah,
who brought down the words of Torah,
and was an elder sitting in yeshivah
corresponding to Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
and the gevuros issue from Binah
עַל יְדֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה מִבִּינָה
through Torah she'b'al peh, from Binah,
that is, the waters of knowledge;
and this corresponds to the middle line,
Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him,
who shines forth from the tip of the yud
that it descends to the shissin, to the depths,
rejoice with every kind of rejoicing,
for the right brings it about," etc.;
"then the rejoicing is for delight," etc.
That is, "the right brings it about" — Chochmah.
וָאֶהְיֶה שַׁעֲשׁוּעִים יוֹם יוֹם (מִשְׁלֵי ח, ל),
"And I was a delight day by day" (Mishlei 8:30),
from which it is expounded (Vayikra Rabbah 19:1)
that the Torah preceded by two thousand years
יוֹמוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶלֶף שָׁנָה;
a day of the Holy One, blessed be He, is a thousand years;
and these are the two attributes, Chochmah and Binah
it is the rejoicing of the Torah,
for then is the union of the body,
the union of all, for all to be one;
and this is the perfection of all," etc.,
"in which the Other has no share."
That is, this corresponds to Techiyas HaMeisim,
when the bodies too will be in holiness,
as was the intent of creation
had there been no downfall at all
which is the first day of Rosh Hashanah;
וְאָז ה׳ בָּדָד יַנְחֶנּוּ (דְּבָרִים לב, יב),
and then "Hashem alone will guide him" (Devarim 32:12),
so that there will be nothing at all of the nations of the world.
And this is what he said above:
"Afterward she is united with the body,
and then all is called One,
then it is the perfection of all."
וְהַיְינוּ דִּקְדוּשַּׁת יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם —
That is, the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him —
כְּעֵין מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פ, ז):
similar to what they said (Bereishis Rabbah 80:7):
וְאָנוּ לְמֵדִין מִפָּרָשָׁתוֹ שֶׁל אוֹתוֹ רָשָׁע:
"And we learn it from the passage of that wicked one:
'And you who cleave to Hashem,' etc."
And the main fulfillment will be in the future,
when the union will be in the body as well,
and the unification will be complete
"And you who cleave to Hashem your God."
